name: Workflows
description: Workflows: petgraph DAG automation with triggers, durable execution, and a natural-language workflow builder.

permission_levels.label: Can view
permission_levels.description: See workflows and their run history, without changing or starting anything.

permission_levels.label: Can run
permission_levels.description: Start a workflow and watch it execute. Implies viewing.

permission_levels.label: Can edit
permission_levels.description: Create and change workflows, including their triggers and steps. Implies running.

permission_levels.label: Can delete
permission_levels.description: Permanently remove a workflow and its run history. Implies editing.
